generated_by: report.py (forensic CPU-load overlap, 2026-11-04 KST); inputs: calls_v4.json (transcripts), gpu_cells.json (run reports), twins.json (episode-file hashes), jobs_curated.json

method.gpu_cell_times: start = host_after.time - wall_s; end = host_after.time (per-cell records). GR-1 training: started/finished of each arm.
method.job_start: timestamp of the assistant tool_use block that launched the job (UTC -> KST).
method.job_end: foreground: timestamp of its tool_result; run_in_background or auto-backgrounded: main = queue-operation enqueue of the completion notification, subagent = attachment record of the notification; detached '&' launches: output-file mtimes in ~/motar_tmp. Phase splits from output/log mtimes.
method.overlap: job [start,end) intersects cell [start,end). Precision about 1 s; tool_result timestamps include under 1 s of harness overhead.
method.classes: heavy = multi-process, >= 60 s, suite, gate, install or clone; moderate = single-process compute 3-60 s; minor = 1.5-3 s script/test/build runs and borderline disk commands (counted separately). Ignored: reads, edits, git status/log/diff/commit (no hooks installed), polls and sleep loops.
method.gpu_job_cpus: every GPU runner was pinned to taskset 0-3,8-11,14-23 (cpu4/5 offline). 6,7,12,13 = two whole P-cores disjoint from that set (i7-13700K, siblings 6-7 and 12-13).
